artboards.title: Promotions — one list for every offer
Promotion detail — stats, budget, live preview

annotations.text:
PLAYER — what changes

1. Lobby. The promo strip is new, and the hero slide is generated from the live first-deposit setting instead of the hard-coded "100% bonus" that ships today. The red chip only appears for a signed-in player holding a bonus.

2. Wallet. New My Bonuses hub: each lot shows its source and a countdown, and Earn More shows real progress toward cashback and the deposit rules. The explainer under the spend toggle is new.

3. Promotions page. Today it shows slogans only, and never shows the daily or weekly deposit rules at all. Every card now carries progress and a payout time.

4. Arrival moments. The bell exists in the codebase but is never mounted, so players currently get no inbox. Panel 3 is that bell.

Worth checking

Numbers are sample values, not real data. Copy is drafted and needs an Amharic pass — the wallet labels are hard-coded English today.

Icons are inline SVG rather than the emoji the app uses in a few places. The bell's current emoji map is missing eight notification types and references two that don't exist, so this replaces it.

Bonus lots have no source column in the database yet, so the source chips need that added before any of this can render.

ADMIN — what changes

Cashback and Bonus Rules merge into one Promotions section, and the welcome bonus joins them instead of hiding under Settings. Outstanding liability and next run time are new.

The detail page is entirely new. Today a promotion can only be created and toggled — no edit, no duplicate, no end, no history, and no way to see who received what. Max payout per player and a period budget are new fields; cashback currently has no cap at all.

Qualifies right now reuses the net-loss query the hourly job already runs, so the admin sees the bill before it is paid.

The two lower screens show the content area only. The sidebar is the same one drawn on the list screen above.

On the player Bonuses tab, note that balance adjustment sits in the admin scope. It is reachable by clerks today with no cap and no record of who did it.
